source.label: theorem:greedy-regret
source.quote: Suppose that Assumption \ref{assumption:basic} holds and that the sets $\CAL U_r$ satisfy the SBAR($J$) condition. Then, there exists a positive constant $a_1$  that depends only on $\sigma_0$, $\bar{u}$,  $\lambda_0$, and $J$,  such that  for any $\BF z \in \Real^r \setminus \{\BF 0\}$ and $T \geq r$, ${\rm Regret} \left( \BF z, \, T,  \, \textsc{PEGE} \right) \leq a_1 \, \left( \norm{\BF z} + \frac{1}{\norm{\BF z}} \right) \,  r    \sqrt{T}$.

results.notes: Corollary 3.3 specialises this to the unit sphere with standard normal noise (absolute constant a_3); not recorded separately.

symbols.a_2: constant depending only on sigma_0, u_bar, lambda_0, J, M

conditions: E||Z|| <= M and E[1/||Z||] <= M for every r

source.label: theorem:greedy-regret
source.quote: Suppose in addition, that there exists a constant $M > 0$ such that for every $r\geq 2$ we have $\E \left[\, \norm{\BF Z} \,\right] \leq M$ and $\E \left[ \,1/\norm{\BF Z} \,\right] \leq M$. Then, there exists a positive constant $a_2$ ... such that for any $T \geq r$, ${\rm Risk} \left( T,  \, \textsc{PEGE} \right) \leq a_2 \, r  \,  \sqrt{T}$.

results.notes: Corollary 3.3 gives the matching bound a_3 r sqrt(T) for unit sphere with N(0,I_r/r) prior.
